title: Subscription payment receipt
description: Send a payment receipt on WhatsApp after a subscription charge, with amount, plan and invoice number. Utility template. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Keep it purely a receipt with an invoice ID; no upsell.

body.text: Thanks, {{first_name}}! We charged *{{amount}}* for your {{plan}} subscription on {{date}}. Your invoice number is {{invoice_id}}, and you can download the full invoice any time using the button below.
